initial_entry.author: Grzegorz Gajos
initial_entry.description: Attention is a currency. Less is more. Tasks Eye saves your attention and reduces friction by returning dated tasks when they need a decision, while your projects, plans, and history stay in Markdown. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
